index-page.title: ETL Developer & Analytics Engineer
index-page.intro: I build reliable data pipelines, dimensional models, and BI workflows that turn messy operational data into decision-ready insights. Recently focused on Python/SQL ETL, dbt quality checks, and cloud automation across AWS and modern data tools.

about-page.text-1: Hey, I'm Daniel. I'm an ETL Developer and Analytics Engineer focused on Python/SQL pipelines, dimensional modeling, and business intelligence workflows.
about-page.text-2: I graduated from the University of Maryland with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (GPA: 3.5) in August 2025.
about-page.text-3: My stack includes Python, SQL, dbt, AWS, Airflow, FastAPI, Power BI, and Tableau for building reliable analytics systems end to end.

tools.title: Tools
tools.text: These are the tools I use daily for data analysis and building data pipelines. I'm always exploring new technologies to improve my workflow.
tools.python: My primary language for data processing, analysis, and automation. I use Pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn extensively.
tools.sql: Essential for data extraction and transformation. I work with MySQL, PostgreSQL, and optimize complex queries for performance.
tools.powerbi: My go-to tool for creating interactive dashboards and business intelligence reports connected to various data sources.
tools.aws: I use AWS services like Glue, Lambda, and EC2 for building scalable ETL pipelines and deploying data applications.
